page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is an accelerator instance from the Compute Optimized with GPU family, managed under the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provided by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, offering 128 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 512.0 GB, delivering an even allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs with 24 GB of VRAM per card, yielding a cumulative total of 192 GB GPU memory. Interconnect and data transfer requirements are supported by a 160 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system configuration includes no onboard local storage, necessitating reliance on remote storage volumes for operating system and application data.

Cost efficiency is influenced by the density of the eight-GPU layout and 128 dedicated host cores, which minimizes host-level virtualization overhead for large parallel tasks. Because storage is not bundled, all I/O is dependent on network-attached storage. The hardware profile is structured for high-throughput AI inference pipelines, cloud workstation virtualization, real-time video encoding, and parallel graphics rendering.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated bare metal server powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B x86_64 processor operating at 2.9 GHz across 128 vCPUs. The platform integrates 512.0 GB of system RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. Acceleration is driven by an array of eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs equipped with 24 GB of VRAM each, yielding 192 GB of total GPU memory. Network throughput is provisioned with a 160 Gbps baseline interface, and the system contains no bundled local storage, relying on external network-attached volumes for I/O requirements. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. With substantial multi-GPU density and high-throughput networking, the instance is engineered for distributed machine learning inference, real-time video transcoding, dense 3D graphics rendering, and compute-heavy scientific simulations requiring parallel GPU offload.
